scope: Static comparison and reference integrity of the merged observation guide. This audit does not run the browser, APK, full test suite or a physical panel.
method: Read the requested baseline through git show; read current files without modifying them.
Match groups by ID, and questions/causes by their IDs within the same group. Compare all original question text strings, cause titles and original likelihood key/value pairs exactly.
Record all changed/added original-record fields. Source arrays are compared by source ID; added references and exact before/after field changes are retained below.
Resolve every question sourceRef and inline cause source ID to the current canonical register; compare inline URL and recordId to the canonical values.
Resolve every non-null source recordId against the bundled catalogue and compare the source and catalogue URLs. This is identity checking, not a fresh publisher download.
Check evidence and scenario identifiers and their answer values. Ranking execution, full release tests, browser checks and packaging belong to the parent release validation.

groups.title: Door will not lock / stays unlocked

compatibility.legacyCompositeQuestionNote: Existing compound questions retain their original IDs and text, including warden-report_0 (mains failure or low system battery) and warden-report_2 (resident unit, pullcord or open circuit). Separate new observations refine them without reinterpreting saved answers.

legacyAnswers.calculation: Half the log likelihood: Probably multiplies by sqrt(p), Probably not by sqrt(1-p). I don’t know has weight zero and leaves candidate weights unchanged.
legacyAnswers.historicalMetadataNote: The baseline knowledge.json metadata spelled the old negative key probably_not, but the baseline engine actually offered/stored probably-not. Current compatibility retains the real runtime key; the metadata discrepancy is not an answer migration.
legacyAnswers.scopeLimit: New causes and questions can change relative ranking and next-question choice. Preserving original answer contributions does not promise identical rankings after expanding the candidate set.

rootMetadata.after: FINDR fire and security observation guide

before.prior: Equal within the chosen symptom group. Never describe equal priors as prevalence.
before.questionChoice: Choose the unanswered question with the greatest expected information gain under current relative weights. Tie-break deterministically.
before.update: Yes multiplies by p, No by 1-p. Probably/Probably not use a square-root likelihood update (half strength). Unknown does not change candidate weights. Recompute from original answers when going back.
before.stopping: At most all available questions. Permit early viewing and continued questioning. If all answers are unknown or no positive distinguishing evidence exists, show unresolved rather than best guess.
before.display: Show up to three possibilities with the matching observations and source references. Do not display probability percentages or say fixed/safe/confirmed.
before.multipleFaults: The model considers one symptom group at a time. Multiple simultaneous faults can have different causes. An unknown/out-of-scope outcome must always be available.

after.prior: Equal within the chosen symptom group. Never describe equal priors as prevalence.
after.questionChoice: Choose the unanswered question with the greatest expected information gain under current relative weights. Tie-break deterministically.
after.update: Yes multiplies by p; No by 1-p. I don’t know makes no change to candidate weights. Recompute from original answers when undoing an answer. Only valid answers to questions in the selected group count as evidence.
after.stopping: At most all available questions. Permit early viewing and continued questioning. If all answers are unknown or no positive distinguishing evidence exists, show unresolved rather than best guess.
after.display: Show up to three possibilities with the matching observations and source references. Do not display probability percentages or say fixed/safe/confirmed.
after.multipleFaults: The model considers one symptom group at a time. Multiple simultaneous faults can have different causes. An unknown/out-of-scope outcome must always be available.
after.legacyAnswers: Older saved Probably / Probably not answers retain their original half-strength weight and are labelled as earlier-session answers. They are not offered in new questions and are never silently strengthened into Yes / No.
